title: Singular partitive with i → e
focus: For this group of words, change final i to e before adding -a/-ä: ovi (“door”) → ovea.

exercises.prompt: Choose the singular partitive of ovi (“door”).
exercises.explanation: Change final i in ovi to e, keep the strong consonants, and add -a: ovea. This is the singular partitive of ovi (“door”).
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Singular partitive with i → e: form or use confused
